Done.

**Bug:** in `paginate`, `end = start + per_page - 1` was off by one exclusion — Python slices `raw_items[start:end]` are end-exclusive, so each page returned one item fewer than `per_page`.

**Fix:** `end = start + per_page` (`toyapp/pagination.py:29`).

**Files changed:** `toyapp/pagination.py` (only the one line).

**Checks run:** `/Users/instructor/Code/odsc-workshop/.workshop-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` → **3 passed**.

**Final git status/diff:** clean aside from the single modified file; diff shown above. No commits made, no dependencies installed, tests untouched.

**Remaining uncertainty:** `page_numbers` and validation logic were left unchanged (tests only cover `paginate` slices); no `total_pages`/`page_numbers` tests exist to verify further behavior.
